From the website: every reading of the day, with text you can make larger.

On the Home page of orthodoxdaily.net, the Scripture card lists the day's readings. Tap one to open the full passage in its own window.

In that window, the − and + buttons make the text smaller or larger, from 90% up to 150%, so the day's Scripture is comfortable to read and pray with.

Full day at the link in our bio.
